_comment: Add one entry per LinkedIn post. date = YYYY-MM-DD. url = the post's permalink. Paste the post text into 'excerpt'. The blog section on the site reads this file and renders the newest first.

posts.title: Accepted is not applied: when a security parameter silently does nothing
posts.excerpt: Silent inaction is worse than absence, because the caller believes the work is done. A finding that is accepted but never verified is an assumption wearing a ticket number.

posts.title: Unreachable is not a control: when authentication becomes decorative
posts.excerpt: An agent memory layer accepted any JWT with its signature unchecked. The remedy was to make the endpoint unreachable, but unreachable is a circumstance, not a control.

posts.title: Read-only is not inert: how a sandbox handed over the host's credentials
posts.excerpt: A read-only proxy forwarded method calls, so sandboxed code subscribed to a host event and received live credentials. Containment is a channel problem, not a permissions problem.
